notes.title: Release Notes - 2024-05-14
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42497319/f8f6d65a4984ba7e8874ed144c77dfeab17316a0.png[/img]

Commander, the latest Situation Report has just arrived!

In the ever-evolving world of mechanized warfare, attention to detail is crucial. Our engineers have been hard at work fine-tuning the systems that drive our war machines to ensure flawless operation on the battlefield. Today, we are excited to announce the successful elimination of several pesky bugs that have been causing minor hiccups in our operations and balancing adjustments.

In our pursuit of balanced and engaging gameplay, we have implemented significant adjustments to enhance the strategic depth of warfare. Zeppelin Dropships will now require an Airbase level 3 for deployment, with increased production time by approximately 45% and a 5-10% cost hike. These adjustments are based on the feedback we received from the frontlines that showed concerns regarding the point of researching commandos. The adjusted availability and costs of Zeppelin Dropships make both a valid option now.

Additionally, we adjusted the morale-based production time. A morale level of 100% will have a 10% reduced production time. 

Thanks to our skilled engineers, kills will now be accurately attributed to the unit that truly earned them, based on the highest amount of damage dealt. No more confusion or misallocations - the true heroes will now receive their due recognition.

Furthermore, we have resolved an issue that could cause construction speed-ups to be erroneously charged twice. Your resources will now be spent efficiently, allowing you to bolster your forces and fortifications without unnecessary costs.

Last but not least, we have enhanced the visual experience by fixing a bug that was causing event and scenario images to appear zoomed in on the overview page. Now, you can admire the intricate details of our world without any unnecessary magnification.

To get a complete overview of all changes in today's update, please check the [url=https://bytro.helpshift.com/hc/en/5-iron-order-1919/faq/484]detailed list[/url] that we prepared for you. 

If you'd like to share your thoughts on today's update or are looking for a great place to discuss strategy with skilled commanders from all around the globe, make sure to check out the [url=https://discord.gg/zXYcgWTFFN]Iron Order Community Discord[/url]!

notes.title: Release Notes - 2024-04-09
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42497319/f8f6d65a4984ba7e8874ed144c77dfeab17316a0.png[/img]

Today's update consists of several game-changing alterations and critical bug fixes to enhance your gameplay experience. Dropships now spawn Commandos instead of Infantry units. The Commandos start at level one with a mobilization time of three hours, and upon spawning, Dropships are removed. Their costs have been increased but come with enhancements; a range increase with level and greater speed.The Commando's manpower and metal costs have been slightly rebalanced, and deploy costs for Sea Factories have been significantly reduced. Plus, converting Sea Factories to Medium Mechs is now possible at level four instead of seven.

As for bug fixes, we have addressed the issue with the Delaying March feature; it now uses real-time hours instead of in-game time which should bring relief to players on maps with a speed factor higher than one.The annoying infinite loading screen bug when playing on Steam has been fixed too.Lastly, readability has been improved in alliance games where all information texts are now well-aligned and the message “You are not part of this alliance game” sits comfortably without distorting the game summary at the bottom. We hope these improvements enhance your gaming experience. Best of luck on the battlefield!

To get a complete overview of all changes in today's update, please check the [url=https://bytro.helpshift.com/hc/en/5-iron-order-1919/faq/479]detailed list[/url] that we prepared for you.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42497319/f8f6d65a4984ba7e8874ed144c77dfeab17316a0.png[/img]

Commander, the latest Situation Report has just arrived!

We’ve adjusted the defensive behavior of stealth units. Stealth units stationed in a province center were able to get locked into combat with attacking armies, without being revealed in the process. To avoid this confusing situation, stationary, defending stealth units are always revealed to the attacker. This happens regardless of whether they are stationed in a province center, or part of a larger army with other, visible units.

Multiple unit-related bugs were fixed. Harpies can no longer be converted outside of allowed areas. Also, when a convertible unit is part of a larger army, giving a conversion command now only converts eligible units.
Selecting the deployment button on the Titan multiple times is no longer possible, which prevents an error message.

We also fixed an issue that caused the health bar in the unit label to display a higher amount of hitpoints than actually available. Now the health bar will accurately reflect the hitpoint-value displayed in the Army Bar.
And finally, the message notification icon for the alliance chat will now display the correct number of new messages.

To get a complete overview of all changes in today's update, please check the [url="https://bytro.helpshift.com/hc/en/5-iron-order-1919/faq/438"]detailed list[/url] that we prepared for you.

Commander, the latest Situation Report has just arrived!

In this update, we've made some important changes to the game's balancing along with a few bug fixes. We've adjusted the availability of research items, making it easier for you to progress in the game. The time between research levels has been reduced, allowing more items to be available earlier and more closely to each other. 

We've also fixed a bug where converting units outside of a province would cause issues. Now, the "Convert" button will be hidden once a moving command is issued to a convertible unit and conversion won't be allowed if the unit isn't in a conversion area. 

Last but not least, we've fixed a problem where the settings drop-down menu wouldn't close when clicked again. Now, it will properly close when you click on it a second time.

Directly observe the results of your actions on the battlefield, and marvel at the destruction!

notes.title: New unit available - Zeppelin Dropship
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42497319/f195f11d4cec5a1edddf3c1ce4c349de0cb8d05c.png[/img]


Commander, the latest Situation Report has just arrived!

The newest addition to the arsenal of units is ready to enter service, the Zeppelin Dropship! It has been one of the most suggested and requested units that you as a community asked for so we're really happy to see the impact it will have on your strategies. The Dropship will act as Iron Order's unique take on Paratroopers, offering new long range, high mobility options when attacking.  

New soundtracks and in-game sounds are available in Iron Order 1919! You probably noticed that Iron Order 1919 shared many sounds with our other World War I game, Supremacy 1914. We are pleased to announce that in this update Iron Order is getting its own soundtracks and many new sound effects to better fit the conflict and setting. 

Aside from that, we made changes to the in-game panels. The game settings panel on mobile devices and army display options were reworked. They now show only relevant information. The map controls panel on desktop was also restructured and was adjusted in the top bar. All this will make user experience better, avoiding duplicates and having solely game-related filters.

For a full overview of all changes please refer to the list below: 

[b]General[/b]

[list][*] The Zeppelin Dropship is added as a new unit. It allows you to deploy infantry in enemy province centers from range and will be available in any game round that starts after today's update. [/*][*]New sounds and music were added to the game. They are absolutely unique and reflect the setting and atmosphere of the game. [/*][*]The game settings panel on mobile was reworked, and duplicates also available in the map controls panel were removed.[/*][*]The map controls panel on desktop was restructured. Buttons were organized to enhance user experience and provide better interface orientation.[/*][*]Completed adviser tasks are now displayed at the top of the list in the adviser task menu. This way you find your completed tasks immediately and do not have to scroll all the way down and search for them anymore.[/*][*]The available army display options were adjusted. This change allows for a better reflection of relevant displays that can be useful for your battle analysis. You can also find a new army display option here which makes it possible to hide unit images and have labels displayed only.[/*][/list]


[b]Bug fixes[/b]

[list][*]A bug was fixed that resulted in an inactive coalition leader keeping the leadership position. When the coalition leader is inactive, the coalition leadership is transferred to the active member with the highest VP score.[/*][*]An issue was resolved that allowed coalition leaders to send invites to join a coalition, even if it was full. No new invites can be sent out anymore when the coalition reached the maximum number of members.[/*][*]A bug was fixed that prevented arrival times to be displayed correctly when dragging idle armies and artillery units.[/*][*]A problem was solved that resulted in coalition flags on mobile not being saved when a random flag was generated. When you create a coalition with the suggested flag by the system, the flag is saved and displayed correctly now.[/*][*]A bug was fixed that displayed alliance battle statistics incorrectly. From now on, the red and blue section of the bars correspond to the actual stats. [/*][*]An issue was resolved that made planes teleport back to airfields when adding additional patrol commands. With this fix, the displayed indication of whether a trade was accepted or rejected is correct again. [/*][*]An issue was resolved that caused spy mission icons to disappear after sending spies to the mission. When deploying a spy, both offensive and defensive mission icons will be shown. We also resolved an issue with the ships that had to cross the entire map to get to the destination and made units not teleport to random locations.

notes.title: Future Content Showcase: Tech Tree
notes.content:
Attention, Generals!

During the following weeks and up to the official release, we will showcase some of the game features in order to best prepare you for the battles to come. The focus of today's news will be on the tech tree and the implications this will have for the general gameplay.

Instead of every regular unit having multiple research levels that would continuously buff their statistics in a very linear way, we want to break this dynamic and make research decisions more meaningful.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42497319/d6b63b5cda255fb36f45804df90744556c73a325.png[/img]

Regular units have a total of 9 research steps, where every step will buff a single stat that is beneficial to the combat role of the unit. By not simply buffing multiple stats at once, individual upgrades will have different effects and therefore be more or less advantageous in different combat scenarios.
The most impactful change however is the introduction of 3 major unit levels that will be unlocked after specific research steps. A majority of units will unlock their 2nd and 3rd major levels with the completion of their 4th and 7th research step. For a few units, this will vary, however, every major level will offer a significant buff to the unit type or even unlock additional combat capabilities. 

Standard infantry will start with the ability to capture provinces at level 1 and receive additional body armor, increasing their maximum health points at level 2. At level 3 they will receive improved rifle designs, slightly boosting their damage output against enemy infantry. At level 4 however, infantry will unlock the ability to utilize cargo planes, allowing them to be airlifted from and to friendly airstrips. According to these changes, a level 3 infantry will still beat a level 1 infantry in single combat in most cases but the unlock of level 4 will add a strategically important capability to the unit, allowing a general to relocate troops much faster in order to outmaneuver the enemy.

Following this example, you should be able to get an idea of how important it will be to plan ahead of time. While you can always research earlier levels later in the game, unlocking major upgrades as soon as possible can put you in a significantly advantageous situation for multiple days.

Of course, we also want to showcase a new unit today that will no doubt be a regular sight on the battlefield. Hot-headed aggressors and defensive masterminds alike will want to utilize the firepower a company of Siege Mechs offers, in order to achieve their goals. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42497319/e7f2ac56f5fb1ef36408c87836b0d5d9e60ea98c.png[/img]


A few things stand out right away when taking a look at the Siege Mech. It fields a long-barrelled, high-caliber gun, allowing it to bombard enemy positions with precision and from a safe distance. In order to do so, it must first deploy and assume its firing stance, as its main armament can not be fired on the move. Both stances are shown in the picture above. 

Compared to regular field artillery the Siege Mech offers another obvious advantage in the form of significant armor plating, allowing it to withstand small arms fire and even some amount of counter-battery fire by enemy artillery.
In regards to the tech tree changes and major unit levels, you might be wondering what kind of additional ability can be unlocked for the Siege Mech. When unlocking its 2nd major unit level, it will gain access to phosphorus grenades, allowing it to lay down a Firestorm barrage, effectively covering a wider area of the battlefield in flames for some time. Your adversaries will have to think twice about continuing their attack if it means having to literally walk through fire.

This concludes today’s feature showcase of the research and unit levels. 
We’re hoping you're as excited about the new strategic possibilities Iron Order 1919 will bring and their implications on the gameplay. Let us know what you think about the designs of the Siege Mech and stay tuned for additional previews in the near future!
